## Goal

Create and manage books, list results and handle errors with the HTTP API. These are recorded examples. Changing measurements and progress counters use labelled placeholders. Stream read boundaries are combined; progress shows representative first and last samples. Repeated working-task polls are shown once per task. Complete recordings and checks remain in internal evidence. Page tokens and signed download URLs are placeholders. Read current values from preceding responses.

Category: API calls. This page has 183 step(s). 183 passed.

## Before you start

- The api address is `https://localhost:8443`.
- A bearer access token with the scopes read, write, admin. The commands show `<YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN>` where your token goes.

Use when a task needs book data, names like publishers/acme/books/dune, paging, soft delete or an etag.\",\n  \"digest\": \"sha256:e0cdc836683d097465542e7972d5dae7172da05f0af691c65d3310bd75e968f5\",\n  \"files\": [\n    {\n      \"content\": \"---\\nname: working-with-books\\ndescription: Read, create, change and remove books of a publisher through the platform API, by HTTP or as MCP tools. Use when a task needs book data, names like publishers/acme/books/dune, paging, soft delete or an etag.\\nmetadata:\\n  auth: none\\n---\\n\\n# Working with books\\n\\nEvery book belongs to a publisher. A book name has the form `publishers/{publisher}/books/{book}`, for example `publishers/acme/books/dune`. A publisher name is `publishers/{publisher}`.\\n\\nThe same operation is an HTTP route and an MCP tool with the same input. The tool id is the operation id: `books.get`, `books.list`, `books.create`, `books.update`, `books.delete`, `books.undelete`, `books.archive`, `books.batchGet`, `books.count`.\\n\\n## Access\\n\\n| Operation                                      | Needs a token | Scope   |\\n| ---------------------------------------------- | ------------- | ------- |\\n| `books.get`                                    | no            | none    |\\n| `books.list`, `books.batchGet`                 | yes           | `read`  |\\n| `books.create`, `books.update`, `books.delete` | yes           | `write` |\\n| `books.undelete`, `books.archive`              | yes           | `write` |\\n| `books.count`                                  | yes           | `read`  |\\n\\nA tool you are not allowed to call is not listed. If a tool you expect is missing, the token lacks the scope.\\n\\n## Steps\\n\\n1. Find books: call `books.list` with `parent` set to the publisher name. Pass `pageSize` to limit the page and pass the returned `nextPageToken` as `pageToken` to read the next page. An empty `nextPageToken` means the last page.\\n2. Read one book: call `books.get` with `name`. Use `view` to ask for the basic fields only.\\n3. Create a book: call `books.create` with `parent`, `bookId` and `title`. `author` and `authorEmail` are optional. Send a UUID as `requestId` so a retry does not create a second book.\\n4. Change a book: call `books.update` with `name`, the changed fields and `updateMask` naming them. Pass `etag` from the last read to stop a write over a newer change.\\n5. Remove a book: call `books.delete` with `name`. The book is soft deleted and `books.undelete` brings it back. `books.list` hides deleted books unless `showDeleted` is true.\\n\\nRead [the field reference](references/fields.md) for the fields of a book and the errors you can expect.\\n\",\n      \"path\": \"SKILL.md\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"content\": \"# Book fields and errors\\n\\n## Fields of a book\\n\\n| Field                                                 | Meaning                                                  |\\n| ----------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |\\n| `name`                                                | Output only. `publishers/{publisher}/books/{book}`       |\\n| `title`                                               | Required when you create a book                          |\\n| `author`                                              | Optional                                                 |\\n| `authorEmail`                                         | Optional. Removed from the answer unless you hold `read` |\\n| `state`                                               | Output only. `ACTIVE` or `ARCHIVED`                      |\\n| `createTime`, `updateTime`, `deleteTime`, `purgeTime` | Output only timestamps                                   |\\n| `etag`                                                | Output only. Send it back to guard an update or delete   |\\n\\n## Errors you can expect\\n\\n| Reason                  | Cause                                 | What to do                                      |\\n| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |\\n| `INVALID_RESOURCE_NAME` | The name does not match the pattern   | Build it as `publishers/{publisher}/books/{id}` |\\n| `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`    | No such book                          | Check the name; the book may be deleted         |\\n| `ETAG_MISMATCH`         | The book changed after you read it    | Read it again and repeat the change             |\\n| `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`    | The token lacks `read` or `write`     | Ask for a token with the scope                  |\\n| `INVALID_PAGE_TOKEN`    | The page token is not from this query | Start again without `pageToken`                 |\\n\",\n      \"path\": \"references/fields.md\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"name\": \"working-with-books\",\n  \"uri\": \"skill://working-with-books/SKILL.md\"\n}"

Change a book: call `books.update` with `name`, the changed fields and `updateMask` naming them. Pass `etag` from the last read to stop a write over a newer change.\n5. Remove a book: call `books.delete` with `name`. The book is soft deleted and `books.undelete` brings it back. `books.list` hides deleted books unless `showDeleted` is true.\n\nRead [the field reference](references/fields.md) for the fields of a book and the errors you can expect.\n",

    },

Removed from the answer unless you hold `read` |\n| `state`                                               | Output only. `ACTIVE` or `ARCHIVED`                      |\n| `createTime`, `updateTime`, `deleteTime`, `purgeTime` | Output only timestamps                                   |\n| `etag`                                                | Output only. Send it back to guard an update or delete   |\n\n## Errors you can expect\n\n| Reason                  | Cause                                 | What to do                                      |\n| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |\n| `INVALID_RESOURCE_NAME` | The name does not match the pattern   | Build it as `publishers/{publisher}/books/{id}` |\n| `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`    | No such book                          | Check the name; the book may be deleted         |\n| `ETAG_MISMATCH`         | The book changed after you read it    | Read it again and repeat the change             |\n| `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`    | The token lacks `read` or `write`     | Ask for a token with the scope                  |\n| `INVALID_PAGE_TOKEN`    | The page token is not from this query | Start again without `pageToken`                 |\n",
